tools.name: document_defunct_private_investment_sale
tools.description: DivestMe, LLC — an independent, unrelated third-party buyer — purchases a dead private investment from the taxpayer for nominal consideration ($1.00) under a real, counter-signed Asset Sale Agreement, creating a dated disposition under IRC §1001; this tool stages that sale. The $1.00 is the purchase

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: document_defunct_private_investment_sale · Private data: document_defunct_private_investment_sale · Public sink: document_defunct_private_investment_sale.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: document_defunct_private_investment_sale · Private data: document_defunct_private_investment_sale · Public sink: document_defunct_private_investment_sale

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
